REPORT
Date April 23. 19 5.

（右上角印章及手写内容：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D-6622）

Subject The Community Tabloid - Harry F. Smith and Don Smith.

Made by ____ Forwarded by D.S.I. E.M. Golder.

At 10 a.m. April 23. 1935 the undersigned paid a visit to
the offices of the New Mission Press, No 5, Lane 134
Nanzing Road. Mr Don Smith, editor of the Community
Tabloid was interviewed and informed of the wishes of the
Deputy Commissioner Special Branch as appended to report
dated April 4. He promised to attend Police Headquarters
at about 12 noon on April 23. 1935.
Further enquiries into the activities of the members of the
staff of the New Mission Press reveal that Harry F Smith
and Don Smith the editor of the paper " Community Tabloid"
are two distinct persons. Harry F. Smith is an American
and a married man who is guilty periodically of failing to/ support
his wife and children. Some months ago he was charged with
the failure to support them and was sentenced by the
American Court to 30 days imprisonment.
After leaving the Amoy Road Gaol at the expiration of his
sentence he obtained a position with the New Mission Press
as accountant or vice-manager but was dismissed about one
week ago owing to there being evidence that he had tampered
with the Company's books. Mr Schmuser, managing-proprietor
of the New Mission Press has laid a complaint against H.F.
Smith whose where-abouts are at present not known. Mr, Felton
Watson, District Attorney has informed the undersigned that
no charge will be brought against Smith, however the Consulate
are anxious to know his where-abouts.
Don Smith who is alleged to be Canadian, is the person who
was at one time on the staff of the Toronto Star and who
was responsible for the article regarding the shooting affray
outside the Hongkew Market which appeared in an issue of

事由 《社区小报》—— Harry F. Smith 和 Don Smith。

制作人 ____ 由副督察长 E.M. Golder 转呈。

1935年4月23日上午10时，具名者走访了位于南京路134弄5号的新使命出版社办公室。会见了《社区小报》编辑 Don Smith 先生，并告知其特务科副总监在4月4日报告附录中的要求。他承诺于1935年4月23日中午12时左右前往警察总局。
对新使命出版社职员活动的进一步调查显示，《社区小报》编辑 Harry F. Smith 和 Don Smith 是两个不同的人。Harry F. Smith 是美国人，已婚，经常犯有不供养妻儿的过错。数月前，他因未履行供养义务被起诉，并被美国法院判处监禁30天。
刑期届满离开厦门路监狱后，他在新使命出版社获得了一个会计或副经理的职位，但因有证据表明他篡改公司账簿，约于一周前被解雇。新使命出版社的经理兼业主 Schmuser 先生已对 H.F. Smith 提出控告，目前尚不知其下落。地区检察官 Felton Watson 先生告知具名者，不会对 Smith 提起诉讼，但领事馆急于知道他的下落。
据称是加拿大人的 Don Smith，曾是《多伦多星报》（Toronto Star）的职员，并负责撰写关于虹口市场外枪击事件的文章，该文刊登在一期

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTER
File No. ____ 6622
Special Branch S.B. 55 Sept 1.35
REPORT
Date ____ April 4, ____ 19 35.

[Subject.] The "Community Tabloid", its publishers and its policy.

[Made by] ____ and ____ Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder. ]

Further enquiries have been made regarding
F. Schmuser, K.A. Niedernhoefer, G. Kuhnle and Herbert
Willweber who are concerned with the printing and
publication of the "Community Tabloid" and regarding
Harry F. Smith alias Don Smith, its editor.
The consensus of opinion regarding them collectively,
is that they are trying to make a living and that they
are fairly straightforward.
The idea of publishing the "Community Tabloid"
was Smith's who in looking round for a partner met
Schmuser, the proprietor of the New Mission Press.
Schmuser who has been in deep water financially for
the past year or so was only too willing to take on
anything that showed the possibility of a profit, thus
he and Smith formed what is known as the Community
Printing & Publishing Company, which, if successful,
will supersede the New Mission Press.
The policy of the paper as explained by Smith
to his friends will be an "outspoken but fair and
constructive criticism of Municipal administration".
[ The back copies of the "Community Tabloid" have
been purchased and arrangements made for the purchase
of the paper in future. ]

（左侧手写批注：）
H.C. (br.)
Information

Em Golder

[事由.] 《社区小报》，其出版商及其方针。

[制作人] ____ 和 ____ 由副督察长 Golder 转呈。 ]

已就参与《社区小报》印刷和出版的 F. Schmuser、K.A. Niedernhoefer、G. Kuhnle 和 Herbert Willweber，以及其编辑 Harry F. Smith（别名 Don Smith）进行了进一步调查。
对他们集体的普遍看法是，他们试图谋生，且为人相当直率。
出版《社区小报》的想法来自 Smith，他在寻找合作伙伴时遇到了新使命出版社的业主 Schmuser。Schmuser 在过去一年左右的时间里财务陷入困境，非常乐意承接任何显示出盈利可能性的业务，因此他和 Smith 成立了所谓的社区印刷出版公司（Community Printing & Publishing Company），如果成功，该公司将取代新使命出版社。
Smith 向朋友解释的该报方针将是“对市政管理进行坦率但公平和建设性的批评”。
[ 《社区小报》的过刊已购买，并安排了今后购买该报的事宜。 ]

（左侧手写批注：）
H.C. (br.)

File No. 6622
Special Branch S. 5 / [此处有涂改痕迹]
REPORT
Date April 2, 19 35.

Subject The "Community Tabloid", a publication interested in
Municipal affairs.

Made by [手写签名] and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder.

The "Community Tabloid", a weekly newspaper,
is printed by the Community Printing Company No. 5/134
Nanzing Road, which is a section of the New Mission
Press, a German concern. Its president and manager
are F. Schmuser and K.A. Niedernhoefer respectively
and both are Germans. The former lives at Flat No. 3,
75 Seward Road and the latter at No. 443 Boone Road.
The employees of the New Mission Press also include
two other Germans named G. Kuhnle and Herbert Willweber.
There is reason to suspect that Willweber's wife was
connected with Communist elements in Budapest.
The editor of the "Community Tabloid", a
Canadian named Harry F. Smith, came to Shanghai about
six months ago. He claims to have formerly worked on
the staff of the Toronto Star. He appears to be a man
of unsettled temperament who goes from job to job.
The "Community Tabloid" has been taking
considerable interest in Municipal affairs and is
inclined to favour movements which are likely to
embarrass the Municipal Council.
Enquiries regarding this organ are being
( continued.

[签名] E.M. Golder
D. S. I.

Deputy Commissioner Special Branch.

报告
日期 1935年4月2日。

事由 《社区小报》，一份关注市政事务的出版物。

制作人 [手写签名] 并由副督察长 Golder 转呈。

《社区小报》是一份周报，
由位于南京路134弄5号的社区印刷公司印刷，该公司是德国企业新使命出版社的一个部门。其总裁和经理分别是 F. Schmuser 和 K.A. Niedernhoefer，两人均为德国人。前者住在西华德路75号3室，后者住在博恩路443号。新使命出版社的雇员还包括另外两名德国人，名为 G. Kuhnle 和 Herbert Willweber。
有理由怀疑 Willweber 的妻子与布达佩斯的共产党分子有关联。
《社区小报》的编辑是一名叫 Harry F. Smith 的加拿大人，约六个月前来到上海。他声称以前曾在《多伦多星报》工作。他似乎是一个性情不定、频繁换工作的人。
《社区小报》一直对市政事务表现出极大兴趣，并倾向于支持那些可能使工部局陷入尴尬境地的运动。
